F3_grind_5m_below_ma200.reason: Kills 50% of 2021-2025 contractor bull winners (fails >=80% retention gate) and is backwards on Semi/WFE (+17.2% 1Y / +29.9% 3Y on blocked semis because semi cycles bottom in 6-12m).

Combo_F1_AND_F3_LongCycle_Only.usage: Display as RED WARNING TAG (requiring manual research check) ONLY on sub16 in {09,10,13}; do NOT hard-delete from scanner because n_blk in Live4 is small (17 across 09+10+13) and cannot halve broad 2010-2020 DK alone.
